# ada-url / serializers

ada-url's own fuzz target `serializers` ([source](source/serializers.cc), unmodified), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over ada (ada-url/ada at e6754478).

Checks 5 properties (listed below); the first, a round trip: IPv4: if try_parse_ipv4_fast(s) = v <= 0xFFFFFFFF then try_parse_ipv4_fast(serializers::ipv4(v)) == v.

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against ada at commit e6754478.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
- IPv4: if try_parse_ipv4_fast(s) = v <= 0xFFFFFFFF then try_parse_ipv4_fast(serializers::ipv4(v)) == v ([lines 61-77](source/serializers.cc#L61-L77)): abort(); not confirmed in the binary.
- percent_decode(percent_encode(s, PATH_PERCENT_ENCODE)) == s for sources containing no %; and percent_encode is the identity when it emits no % ([lines 149-167](source/serializers.cc#L149-L167)): abort(); not confirmed in the binary.
- is_normalized_windows_drive_letter(s) implies is_windows_drive_letter(s) ([lines 222-230](source/serializers.cc#L222-L230)): abort(); confirmed in the binary.
- A URL built from the serialized fuzzed IPv6 address, if it parses, re-parses to the identical href ([lines 281-298](source/serializers.cc#L281-L298)): abort(); not confirmed in the binary.

A failure of the check at lines 222-230 ends the process with a status that the halts statements below that name it exclude, so a proof of one of those statements implies it on every input it covers. No statement here proves the other checks.

## Builds
Static riscv64 Linux programs, compiled for RV64G and run as `<file> <input-file>`; `oft fetch ada-url` downloads the published ones and checks each against its SHA-256.

Each build also links code that no sanitizer instruments, as its link recorded it. A statement about a sanitizer build covers that code only as uninstrumented code: ASan checks no load or store made inside it, and UBSan inserts no check there.

- plain: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc++.a` (the C++ runtime), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
- ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc++.a` (the C++ runtime), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
